FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS, SECTOR 25,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014
Advertisement for Project Associate-I
Applications are invited along with the complete bio-data and attested copies of certificates showing
qualifications and experience for one post of Project Associate-I in the research project entitled
“Development of novel molecules for functional Parathyroid tumor(s) imaging by
targeting calcium sensing receptor” by DBT, Government of India granted to Dr. Ravi Pratap
Barnwal (PI) and Dr. Gurpal Singh and Dr. Ashok K. Yadav (coPIs). Intial appointment is for one
year, extended up to 3 years based on the performance. Applications should reach the undersigned by
08/07/2026 either by post or email at barnwal@pu.ac.in
Eligibility: M.Sc. in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Chemistry/allied subjects
with minimum 55% marks. “Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/PU PhD (Biophysics)/ other national
entrance test conducted by Government of India will be preferred.”
Age: 30 years (maximum)
Desirable: Experience with peptide, in silico work, amtimicrobial work and nanotechnology
Emoluments: Rs. 31,000/-p.m. (+18% HRA) for three years as per DBT or Panjab University
guidelines.
Yours sincerely
/SD
Ravi Pratap Barnwal, Ph.D.
Department of Biophysics, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with project.
Candidates should mention their email address and phone number in the bio data.
